holderQuote: That’s the second skill I learned. [Flawless Dodge].
effectQuote: I twist out of the way, gracefully for a guy my size. One step, and the huge lizard man misses me by a fraction of a millimeter.

holderQuote: I probably can, actually. If it’s part of my [Flawless Dodge] routine or…heck, I learned how to do an okay cartwheel. But I’m not certain why the [Princess] is here, and I’m busy looking around for the guards that should be around her.

effectQuote: He blocked one with his cudgel then threw himself sideways.

Thomast broke off the lunge mid-strike and turned. Two arrows and three darts flickered at Bethal. She turned, lurching left, too slow. Thomast appeared in front of her. He slashed four times, so fast that she couldn’t see his blade move. But the wind and his sword cut down all five missiles mid-flight. Thomast slapped the mare’s flanks and then the stallion’s as the [Assassins] repositioned, shouting at each other.
